recognize_zh: 皮膚表皮角質細胞明顯細胞內水腫、網狀變性（reticular degeneration），被拉長成細絲狀並形成表皮內水泡，真皮乳頭層有淋巴球浸潤與紅血球外滲；這是水痘樣（hydroa vacciniforme）病灶的表皮水泡期變化，需搭配真皮的EBV陽性T/NK細胞浸潤判斷。
features: Epidermis with marked intracellular edema and reticular degeneration, keratinocytes stretched into thin strands
Formation of intraepidermal vesicles/spaces with a preserved basket-weave stratum corneum
Scattered lymphocytes within the degenerating epidermis
Papillary dermis with lymphocytic infiltrate, edema and extravasated red cells
No multinucleated viral cytopathic keratinocytes evident in this field
describe_en: Skin biopsy shows an epidermis with marked intracellular edema and reticular degeneration, with keratinocytes stretched into thin strands forming intraepidermal vesicles beneath an intact basket-weave stratum corneum. Scattered lymphocytes are present within the epidermis, and the papillary dermis shows edema, a lymphocytic infiltrate and extravasated red cells. Multinucleated keratinocytes with viral inclusions are not identified. These changes represent an early vesiculating lesion; in the appropriate clinical setting with a dermal EBV (EBER)-positive cytotoxic T/NK-cell infiltrate, they are consistent with hydroa vacciniforme lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: Herpesvirus vesicles show ballooning keratinocytes with multinucleation, nuclear molding and margination, which are not seen here.
Erythema multiforme shows basal vacuolar change with numerous apoptotic keratinocytes rather than reticular degeneration with a dense dermal EBV-positive infiltrate.
Classic self-limited HV has a sparse infiltrate with few EBER-positive cells and no systemic disease, whereas HV-LPD shows a denser, deeper EBV-positive T/NK infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous CD8+ aggressive epidermotropic T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: This lymphoma shows pagetoid epidermotropism by atypical CD8+ cells with epidermal necrosis and is EBER-negative.
